title: Fire-protection plans
description: data/fire.json, schema 2.0 (1.0 plus `legend_lines`, and a background that may be a page of a document) -- every fire-protection plan drawn in Woodcore's «Plan de protection incendie» tab, as show-fire-plan reads it: the frame the report shows, the figure drawn over it once per language (data/fire/<id>-<lang>.svg), its background, its scale, and what it draws with what each measures. Written by calc/domains/fire.py (prepare, write), never by hand. Every rule the walker below cannot express is checked by validation.validate_fire_business.

schema_version.description: -- 2.0, or 2.1 where a plan carries `texts` (issue #43): a file written at another version is refused rather than read as this one. 2.2 (issue #64): 2.1 with the figures and the background named from the Typst root (`/Plans/Fire-plan/Exports/Figures/F01-fr.svg`), written by a project laid out by folders.

plans.description: One record per plan, keyed by its id -- the file name of its source and the string the report addresses it by --, in file-name order.

name.description: What the engineer calls the plan; may be empty.

label.description: Its description, which the figure's caption prints; may be empty.

source.description: The source file it was built from, fire/<id>.json.

plan.description: The id of the position plan it follows; absent for a plan with a frame of its own.

sheet.description: The sheet it is drawn on, in the background's own units.

crop.description: The part of the sheet the report shows: its own, or the position plan's it follows.

unit.description: The drawing's unit in sheet units, the crop's longer side over 850: what every size that is no length of the building is a multiple of.

style.description: The plan's own size factors, as the figure was drawn with them.

figures.description: The figure, drawn once per language since its legend carries words: the language -> its file under data/.

legend.description: Whether the figure carries a legend, which show-fire-plan may leave out.

background.description: The architect's plan under the figure: a file of its own under data/fire/ (fire/<id>-plan.<format>, a file of the project or a page of a document), or -- for a plan that follows a position plan -- that plan's own exported background under data/plans/. Absent for a plan drawn on an empty sheet.

document.description: The document of plans/documents/ the background was made from, for a plan drawn on one of its pages; absent otherwise.

rotation.description: The rotation the document's page was given, degrees clockwise.

layers_off.description: The layers of the document that were switched off when the page was flattened.

scale.description: Absent for a plan without a scale, on which nothing is measured.

zones.description: The surfaces of a kind, each with its area where the plan has a scale. A surface that states no kind is a draft and is not exported.

style.description: The factors this entry states over the plan's own (calc/domains/figure_style.py); absent, it states none.

opacity.description: How opaque the entry is drawn, where it states it.

walls.description: The walls with their fire resistance and their length.

style.description: The factors this entry states over the plan's own (calc/domains/figure_style.py); absent, it states none.

opacity.description: How opaque the entry is drawn, where it states it.

doors.description: The doors: how each opens, its fire resistance where it has one, its width.

style.description: The factors this entry states over the plan's own (calc/domains/figure_style.py); absent, it states none.

opacity.description: How opaque the entry is drawn, where it states it.

routes.description: The escape routes' lengths: what each writes, and what it measures.

style.description: The factors this entry states over the plan's own (calc/domains/figure_style.py); absent, it states none.

opacity.description: How opaque the entry is drawn, where it states it.

style.description: The factors this entry states over the plan's own (calc/domains/figure_style.py); absent, it states none.

opacity.description: How opaque the entry is drawn, where it states it.

widths.description: The escape routes' widths: what each writes, and what it measures.

style.description: The factors this entry states over the plan's own (calc/domains/figure_style.py); absent, it states none.

opacity.description: How opaque the entry is drawn, where it states it.

legend_lines.description: The legend's lines, in the order the figure writes them, for the report's own: show-fire-plan's legend and an export sheet's sheet-fire-legend set each swatch beside its text in the report's typeface, as a position plan's legend is. Present for a plan that draws something the legend lists, empty otherwise.

key.description: What the line is: wall:<class>, surface:<kind>, exit, length, width, door:<kind>:<class> (door:<kind> for one without a fire resistance).

text.description: The line's words in the sheet's own German, or -- a door without a fire resistance -- the engine's; the report translates them through `term` or `engine`.

term.description: The German term of the glossary `text` stands for, where it is one (a word of the VKF sheet).

engine.description: The glossary key of the engine's own word, where `text` is one (fire.door.<kind>).

swatch.description: The symbol, as an SVG document of about 10 x 4 mm (fire_svg.legend_swatch).

texts.description: The texts placed with the Text tool (issue #43): what each printed. Absent where the drawing has none.

text.description: Its token text, as the source holds it.

lines.description: Its lines as printed, every token replaced by its variable.

links.description: Where each variable it printed came from (REQ-012).

origin.description: 'formulas' for a domain of the «Formules» tab, whose id is `instance`; absent for the export.

stale.description: True where the variable could not be read and its last value was printed (D-06).
